papers.title: Additive manufacturing of cermet produced by laser powder bed fusion using alternative Ni binder
papers.abstract: Abstract. Cermets are composite materials made of a ceramic reinforcement and a metal matrix, generally cobalt as binder, with mass content from 6 to 20 wt.%. Cermets are produced by conventional sintering process and are known for their high hardness, low friction coefficient, high wear resistance, and high melting temperature. Laser Powder Bed Fusion (L-PBF) is an additive manufacturing technology widely applied for direct fabrication of functional metallic parts with complex geometry such as internal channels or lattices structures. Considering several studies, production of cermets by L-PBF process is challenging. Recent publications have demonstrated the feasibility to produce WC-Co parts by L-PBF combined with Hot Isostatic Pressure (HIP) heat-treatment. HIP process is sometimes additionally performed as post-treatment to remove defects. HIP is performed at high temperatures and isostatic pressures in a furnace [1]. In this study, following an experimental design a parametric optimization was conducted in order to maximize the mass density of WC-17Ni. Process parameters were compared to those used for WC-17Co parts from recent study [2]. To improve the printed specimen integrity, the as-built samples were heat-treated. As-built and HIP samples were analyzed and compared in terms of mass density, microstructure, crystallographic phases, and macro hardness.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化激光粉末床熔融工艺参数制备WC-Ni金属陶瓷。
summary_zh.method: 通过实验设计进行参数优化，并对打印件进行热等静压后处理。
summary_zh.result: 成功制备了高致密度WC-Ni金属陶瓷部件。
summary_zh.validation: 通过密度、微观结构和宏观硬度分析验证。

summary_en.motivation: This work aims to optimize laser powder bed fusion process parameters for fabricating dense WC-Ni cermet parts.
summary_en.method: An experimental design approach was used for parametric optimization, followed by hot isostatic pressing post-treatment to improve integrity.
summary_en.result: High-density WC-Ni cermet specimens were successfully produced with controlled microstructure and hardness.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through mass density measurements, microstructural analysis, crystallographic phase identification, and macro hardness testing.

papers.title: Porous structure design and properties of dental implants
papers.abstract: At present, selective laser melting (SLM) 3D printing technology can accurately control the internal pore structure and complex cell shape. Three types of reticulated meshes with cubic, G7 and composite structure cell shapes were fabricated by the SLM 3D printing technology using Ti-6Al-4V alloy powders. The bone stresses around the implant and the stresses in the implant were analyzed by ANSYS finite element software, which comprehensively evaluated the effect of porous dental implants with different spatial porosity characteristics on osseointegration. The results show that porous dental implants with composite structure of pore characteristics have improved mechanical and biological properties and can better promote the growth and integration of bone tissue.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文通过SLM制备多孔牙科植入物并进行有限元应力分析，直接关联到骨整合和应力遮挡问题。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not include experimental mechanical testing (fatigue or static), surface roughness characterization, or as-built morphology analysis; validation is only through finite element simulation.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用SLM技术设计多孔牙科植入物以改善骨整合。
summary_zh.method: 用SLM制备三种单元结构的多孔钛合金植入物，并用ANSYS进行应力分析。
summary_zh.result: 复合结构多孔植入物具有更好的力学和生物学性能，促进骨生长。
summary_zh.validation: 有限元模拟分析验证应力分布和骨整合效果。

summary_en.motivation: To design porous dental implants via SLM for improved osseointegration.
summary_en.method: Three porous Ti-6Al-4V implants with different unit cell structures were fabricated by SLM and analyzed using ANSYS FEA.
summary_en.result: The composite porous structure exhibited superior mechanical and biological performance, promoting bone ingrowth.
summary_en.validation: Finite element simulation was used to evaluate stress distribution and osseointegration potential.

papers.title: Prediction of surface topography change during chain of selective laser melting and burnishing
papers.abstract: Abstract. The present study developed theoretical models for simulation of surface topography and roughness of parts produced by the selective laser melting (SLM) process and their evolution after burnishing as post-treatment. The simulation algorithm has been integrated by combining principles of selective laser melting process, i.e., formation of the melt pool and kinematic of motion, followed by mechanic of burnishing through Z-map approach. To verify the simulation results, 316L stainless steel was 3D printed and then burnished under different burnishing depth. 3D surface profile and surface roughness of as-printed material and those post-processed by surface burnishing (SB) were measured through microscopic examination and surface roughness measurement, respectively. The results obtained through comparison of confirmatory experiments and simulation model affirmed that the proposed approach is accurate enough to predict the surface topography and roughness of as-printed and post-treated samples.

summary_en.motivation: To develop a theoretical model for predicting surface topography evolution during selective laser melting and subsequent burnishing.
summary_en.method: A simulation algorithm integrating melt pool formation, kinematic motion, and burnishing mechanics via the Z-map approach.
summary_en.result: The proposed model accurately predicts surface roughness of as-printed and burnished 316L stainless steel.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation using 3D surface profilometry and roughness measurements.

papers.title: Study of the Structure and the Destruction Surface of the Dampers Manufactured by the Selective Laser Melting
papers.abstract: The properties of dampers manufactured by the selective laser melting are investigated. Microswear with different elastic and plastic properties were found. The texture of dampers samples represents a non-uniform supplement structure of crushed grains, separated by layers with dispersoids of crystallization of varying completion stages.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究SLM制造的阻尼器，与用户研究的生物医用方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical context, no porous structure for stress shielding, no LPBF fabrication with mechanical testing for implants, no fatigue or surface roughness characterization relevant to osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM制造阻尼器的结构与破坏面特性。
summary_zh.method: 通过SLM制造阻尼器样品，分析其微观结构和破坏面。
summary_zh.result: 发现微磨损具有不同弹塑性，纹理为不均匀的补充结构。
summary_zh.validation: 未涉及实验验证，仅观察和描述。

summary_en.motivation: This paper investigates the structure and destruction surface of dampers fabricated by selective laser melting to understand their mechanical behavior.
summary_en.method: Samples were manufactured by SLM and analyzed for microstructure and fracture surface characteristics using microscopy.
summary_en.result: The dampers exhibited microswear with varying elastic and plastic properties, and the texture showed a non-uniform supplementary structure of crushed grains.
summary_en.validation: No specific validation beyond material characterization was performed.
